headword: {取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}
reading: とらぬたぬきのかわざんよう
gloss: counting one's chickens before they hatch

definitions.gloss: counting one's chickens before they hatch
definitions.explanation: Making plans that depend on a gain one does not have yet; literally, reckoning the price of the pelt of a raccoon dog not yet caught.

examples.japanese: {取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}だ。
examples.english: That's counting your chickens before they hatch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たったら→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Planning for a lottery win is counting your chickens before they hatch.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{道|みち}→使い道：07798_tsukaimichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}だ。
examples.english: Discussing how to spend the profits when the contract isn't even settled is counting our chickens before they hatch.

notes:
⟦{取|と}らぬ→取る：00565_toru⟧ is the classical negative of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (⟦{取|と}らない→取る：00565_toru⟧). The proverb is often shortened to {皮算用|かわざんよう}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}だ: ... is counting your chickens
- {取|と}らぬ{狸|たぬき}の{皮算用|かわざんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end up as wishful planning
- {皮算用|かわざんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to count one's chickens

WRITING:
Also written ⟦{捕|と}らぬ→捕る：28715_toru⟧⟦{狸|たぬき}→狸：04341_tanuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮算用|かわざんよう}, with a different kanji for とる.
